scope: Finite source-backed exact NPC additions loaded into the existing story map once at startup. Not every NPC,all branches,dynamic greetings or observed live colour layouts.

records.speaker: Baker
records.source: [NPC] Baker: At the end of each year I bake cakes for everyone in town to celebrate the year.
records.translation: [NPC] Baker: В конце каждого года я пеку торты для всех горожан в честь праздника.

records.speaker: Baker
records.source: [NPC] Baker: I made one especially for you, here you go.
records.translation: [NPC] Baker: Вот, этот я испёк специально для тебя.

records.speaker: Baker
records.source: [NPC] Baker: Wondering where to store your cakes? You can buy a New Year Cake Bag from me. Click me again to open my shop!
records.translation: [NPC] Baker: Не знаешь, где хранить торты? Купи у меня сумку новогодних тортов. Нажми на меня ещё раз, чтобы открыть магазин!

records.speaker: Baker
records.source: [NPC] Baker: My Wheat Minions produce the finest flour around, but they can't keep up with today's demand...
records.translation: [NPC] Baker: Мои пшеничные миньоны производят лучшую муку в округе, но сегодня они не справляются со спросом...

records.speaker: Baker
records.source: [NPC] Baker: "Use better minion fuel"? But... what could possibly be better than Enchanted Bread?.
records.translation: [NPC] Baker: «Использовать топливо получше»? Но... что может быть лучше зачарованного хлеба?

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: It's time to play SkyBlock Bingo!
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: Пора играть в Бинго SkyBlock!

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: If you join, you have 7 days to complete as many tasks as you can on a fresh, temporary profile!
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: Присоединяйся! У тебя будет 7 дней, чтобы выполнить побольше заданий на новом временном профиле.

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: You have 7 days to complete as many tasks as you can on a fresh, temporary profile!
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: У тебя есть 7 дней, чтобы выполнить побольше заданий на новом временном профиле!

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: Complete personal tasks and work towards Community Goals to earn Bingo Points.
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: Выполняй личные задания и общие цели, чтобы получать очки Бинго.

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: At the end of the event, your Bingo profile will be deleted.
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: После события твой профиль Бинго будет удалён.

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: But don't fret, all of the Bingo Points you earn during the event will stick around!
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: Но не волнуйся: все заработанные за событие очки Бинго сохранятся!

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: You can spend these points in the Bingo Shop on any profile!
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: Эти очки можно потратить в магазине Бинго с любого профиля!

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: I will stick around for a bit longer, but then I'll be gone until next event at the start of the month!
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: Я ещё немного побуду здесь, а потом уйду до следующего события в начале месяца!

records.speaker: Bingo
records.source: [NPC] Bingo: Check out the Bingo Shop to spend Bingo Points while supplies last!
records.translation: [NPC] Bingo: Загляни в магазин Бинго и потрать очки Бинго, пока товары не закончились!

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: Hello!!!
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: Привет!!!

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: I'm the proud owner of the Chocolate Factory!
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: Я — гордый владелец Шоколадной фабрики!

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: My Chocolate is the finest chocolate in the entire world.
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: Мой шоколад — лучший в мире.

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: I have a brand new marketing strategy, and every Spring season I will spread various Rabbit Eggs across the islands.
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: У меня новая рекламная идея: каждую весну я буду прятать кроличьи яйца на островах.

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: Collect all the Rabbits I left in those eggs and I will let you use my factory!
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: Собери всех кроликов из этих яиц — и я разрешу пользоваться фабрикой!

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: Happy egg hunting!
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: Удачной охоты за яйцами!

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ What? You want my Abiphone contact?
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Что? Хочешь мой контакт в Абифоне?

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Well, tell you what. Help me out with a little something and I'll hook you up.
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Давай так: поможешь мне с одним делом — дам свой номер.

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ There's this one Fish that keeps munching on my chocolate stash.
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Одна рыба постоянно поедает мои запасы шоколада.

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ If I ever get him, I'm making a meal out of him - a little payback for all that chocolate.
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Поймаю — приготовлю из него ужин. Отомщу за весь съеденный шоколад!

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Bring me a Fish Chocolat à la Vapeur and I'll give you my contact. Deal?
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Принеси рыбу в шоколаде на пару — и получишь мой номер. Договорились?

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Thank you so much, here is my contact.
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Огромное спасибо! Вот мой номер.

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ If I have new rabbit arrivals, I'll let you know!
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Сообщу, когда появятся новые кролики!

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Bring me that Fish...but in steamed form!
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Принеси ту рыбу... но приготовленную на пару!

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ I just got a new Chocolate Rabbit and was wondering if you wanted to buy it.
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ У меня появился новый шоколадный кролик. Хочешь купить?

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Nice doing business with you.
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Приятно иметь с тобой дело.

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ See you around!
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ До встречи!

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Alright, maybe next time.
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: ✆ Ладно, может, в другой раз.

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: Hoppity's Hunt is on, and I need a break! Got something sweet?
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: Охота Хоппити в разгаре, а мне нужен перерыв! Есть что-нибудь сладкое?

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: Simply exquisite! I don't think I'll ever get tired of chocolate.
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: Превосходно! Шоколад мне никогда не надоест.

records.speaker: Hoppity
records.source: [NPC] Hoppity: Oh...stingy, aren't we?
records.translation: [NPC] Hoppity: Ох... жадничаем, да?

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: During the Spooky Festival, you can collect Candy by killing mobs or fishing.
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: На Жутком фестивале конфеты можно добывать, убивая мобов или рыбача.

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: I accept Candy in exchange for exclusively spooky items!
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: Меняю конфеты на эксклюзивные жуткие предметы!

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: Each Spooky Festival, the top Candy-collecting players can earn even spookier rewards!
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: На каждом Жутком фестивале лучшие собиратели конфет получают ещё более жуткие награды!

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: Click me again to open my shop.
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: Нажми на меня ещё раз, чтобы открыть магазин.

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ You want to be able to call me anytime?
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ Хочешь звонить мне когда угодно?

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ Well that's not possible, I'm only available at night.
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ Не выйдет: я доступен только ночью.

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ If you give me 64 Purple Candy and 6 Ectoplasm, I might give you my contact.
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ Дашь мне 64 фиолетовые конфеты и 6 эктоплазм — возможно, получишь мой номер.

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ Mhm... Your face just isn't very scary...
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ М-м... Лицо у тебя совсем не страшное...

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ But it's not your fault I suppose, here take my contact.
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ Но ты, пожалуй, не виноват. Держи мой номер.

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ Listen buddy it's not because I gave you my contact that it gives you the right to wake me up in the middle of the day.
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ Слушай, приятель: мой номер не даёт тебе права будить меня посреди дня.

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ Call me back tonight or I'm blocking you.
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: ✆ Перезвони ночью, иначе заблокирую.

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: Mortal, the time of reckoning is near. The Past will light the future.
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: Смертный, час расплаты близок. Прошлое озарит будущее.

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: May your destiny be ridded with fortune.
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: Да сопутствует тебе удача.

records.speaker: Fear Mongerer
records.source: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: Soon.
records.translation: [NPC] Fear Mongerer: Скоро.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Here, you'll be able to partake in fun activities, earn Carnival Tokens, and purchase cool prizes!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Здесь можно развлекаться, зарабатывать карнавальные жетоны и покупать отличные призы!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Each day, I'll give you 25x Carnival Tickets, which will let you play the games.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Каждый день дам тебе 25 карнавальных билетов для участия в играх.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: You'll also gain Carnival Tickets for participating in different Events!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Карнавальные билеты также дают за участие в разных событиях!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Here, I'll give you some to start things off.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Держи несколько для начала.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Alright, you should be good to go!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Ну вот, теперь всё готово!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: If you have any questions, come find me.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Будут вопросы — обращайся.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Good luck, and have A Carnivalot of Fun™!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Удачи и карнавально весёлого отдыха™!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: It's a new day, which means you get more Carnival Tickets!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Новый день — новые карнавальные билеты!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Remember, if you have any questions, I'll be right here.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Помни: будут вопросы — я здесь.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Alrighty.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Ладненько.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Currently, The Carnival offers 3 different games!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Сейчас на Карнавале есть 3 игры!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Behind me is Fruit Digging.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Позади меня — «Поиск фруктов».

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Try your luck in this sand-flinging adventure and win big!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Покопайся в песке, испытай удачу и сорви куш!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Over there is Zombie Shootout.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Вон там — «Стрельба по зомби».

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Aim for a high score by killing the pesky Zombies walking around the arena!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Убивай зомби на арене и набирай побольше очков!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Lastly, there's Catch a Fish, located by the mountain pond.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: А у горного пруда — «Поймайте рыбу».

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Catch some fish and have a relaxing time!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Порыбачь и отдохни!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: It's A Carnivalot of Fun™!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Карнавально весело™!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Any other questions?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Есть ещё вопросы?

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Oh, that's easy!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: О, это просто!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Each day, I'll give you 25x Carnival Tickets.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Каждый день дам тебе 25 карнавальных билетов.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: By competing in Carnival games!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Участвуй в карнавальных играх!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: You'll be awarded 1 Token for every 100 points you earn.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Получишь 1 жетон за каждые заработанные 100 очков.

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Why, at the orange stand right over there!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: В оранжевой палатке, вон там!

records.speaker: Carnival Leader
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Leader: You can exchange your Tokens for permanent buffs in different Events throughout SkyBlock, as well as some fun masks to play around with.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Leader: Меняй жетоны на постоянные бонусы для событий SkyBlock и забавные маски.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Welcome to Catch a Fish, friend!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Добро пожаловать в «Поймайте рыбу», друг!

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Mayor Foxy graciously allowed me to use this pond for my attraction.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Мэр Фокси любезно разрешила устроить мой аттракцион на этом пруду.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Anyways, the rules of the game are as follows:
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Итак, правила такие:

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: You will be given 100s to catch some fish with a fishing rod I will provide you.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Дам тебе удочку и 100 с на ловлю рыбы.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Each type of fish has a different color and point value.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Каждый вид рыбы отличается цветом и количеством очков.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Try to catch as many as you can before the time runs out.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Поймай побольше, пока время не вышло.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: So, interested in playing?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Ну что, хочешь сыграть?

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Sorry friend, but it looks like you don't have the 5x Carnival Tickets required to play...
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Извини, друг, но для игры нужно 5 карнавальных билетов. У тебя их нет...

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Maybe next time.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Может, в другой раз.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Well, here goes...
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Ну, начнём...

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Good luck, friend!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Удачи, друг!

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Alas, not everyone can appreciate the art of fishing...
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Увы, не каждому дано оценить искусство рыбалки...

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: I'll be waiting here if you change your mind again.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Снова передумаешь — буду ждать здесь.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Are you here to play?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Пришёл поиграть?

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Of course!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Конечно!

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Would you like to play?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Хочешь сыграть?

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: I'll be waiting here if you change your mind.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Передумаешь — буду ждать здесь.

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Aww, the Carnival is closing for the year now. There's always a next time!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Эх, Карнавал в этом году закрывается. Приходи в следующий раз!

records.speaker: Carnival Fisherman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: This server's as slow as reeling in a heavy catch, can't play the game like this. Sorry, friend!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Fisherman: Сервер еле шевелится — будто тащит тяжёлый улов. Так не поиграть. Извини, друг!

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Howdy there, partner!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Здорово, напарник!

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Interested in playin' Zombie Shootout, are ya?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Хочешь сыграть в «Стрельбу по зомби»?

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Them rules are quite easy to get the hang of.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Правила проще простого.

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: I give ya a fancy lil' dart stick, you shoot sum Zombies!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Дам тебе славный дротикомёт — стреляй по зомби!

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Ye'll get more score based on what armor the Zombie.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Чем лучше броня на зомби, тем больше очков.

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Ye'll get more score based on what armor the Zombie's wearin'.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Чем лучше броня на зомби, тем больше очков.

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: There'll also be sum Redstone Lamps aroun' the arena that can be shot fer points when they light up!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Ещё на арене есть редстоуновые лампы. Загорятся — стреляй и получай очки!

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: That all make sense to ya?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Всё понятно?

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Wouldja like to play Zombie Shootout?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Сыграешь в «Стрельбу по зомби»?

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: I won't keep ya, then.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Тогда не задерживаю.

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Sorry pal, but ya need 5x Carnival Tickets to play!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Извини, приятель, для игры нужно 5 карнавальных билетов!

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Guess we'll have to save it fer later.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Похоже, придётся отложить.

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Are ya ready to play now?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Ну что, теперь готов?

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Well, gosh darn it!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Вот ведь незадача!

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Stop wasting my time then, will ya?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Тогда не трать моё время, ладно?

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Aw shucks, the Carnival is about to close! Hope to see yer next time.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Эх, Карнавал вот-вот закроется! Жду тебя в следующий раз.

records.speaker: Carnival Cowboy
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: This server's draggin' like a tired old mule, can't wrangle this game right now. Sorry, partner!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Cowboy: Сервер плетётся, как уставший мул. Сейчас не поиграть. Извини, напарник!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Welcome to Fruit Digging, matey!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Добро пожаловать в «Поиск фруктов», дружище!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: The rules of the game are as follows - I give ye a shovel, ye dig up the sand on the lookout fer fruit!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Правила такие: дам тебе лопату — копай песок, ищи фрукты!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: The rules are as follows - I give ye a shovel, ye dig up the sand on the lookout fer fruit!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Правила такие: дам тебе лопату — копай песок, ищи фрукты!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: There's a bunch o' different fruits, each with differin' point values and abilities.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: У каждого фрукта свои очки и способности.

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Ye can RIGHT CLICK with yer shovel to swap between dowsing modes, which give ye a little info every time ye dig!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Нажимай ПКМ с лопатой, чтобы менять режимы поиска. При каждом раскопе получишь подсказку!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Yer supposed to use that info to avoid them bombs and pick the best blocks to mine.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: По подсказкам обходи бомбы и выбирай, где лучше копать.

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: It might all sound a little confusin', but I bet ye'll get the hang of it if ye give it a try.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Звучит мудрёно, но попробуешь — быстро разберёшься!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: What do ye say?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Ну что скажешь?

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Ahoy there, matey!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Йо-хо-хо, дружище!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Would ye like to do some Fruit Digging?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Займёшься «Поиском фруктов»?

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Here's yer shovel, then.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Тогда держи лопату.

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Sorry lad, but ye don't have 5x Carnival Tickets. Ye gotta pay to play!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Прости, малый, у тебя нет 5 карнавальных билетов. За игру надо платить!

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Ye'll have to get yer nutrients elsewhere.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Придётся искать пропитание в другом месте.

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: With that said, are ye ready to play?
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Ну что, готов играть?

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: A swashbucklin' shame, if ye ask me...
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: По-пиратски обидно, скажу я тебе...

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Whenever ye be ready, I'll be waitin'
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Будешь готов — я жду.

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Blimey! The Carnival is about to close. Ye'll gotta come back next time.
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Тысяча чертей! Карнавал закрывается. Приходи в следующий раз.

records.speaker: Carnival Pirateman
records.source: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Arrr, this server be slower than a sea turtle in a storm! No chance we be playin' this game, matey. Sorry!
records.translation: [NPC] Carnival Pirateman: Ар-р, сервер медленнее морской черепахи в шторм! Так не поиграть, дружище. Прости!

records.speaker: Sloth
records.source: [SECURITY] Sloth: Downloading suspicious mods or visiting untrusted discord servers can put your account at risk. It is up to you to keep your account secure!
records.translation: [SECURITY] Sloth: Подозрительные моды и недоверенные серверы Discord угрожают вашему аккаунту. Его безопасность зависит от вас!

records.speaker: Oringo
records.source: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ My contact?!
records.translation: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ Мой номер?!

records.speaker: Oringo
records.source: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ What an unusual request!
records.translation: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ Какая необычная просьба!

records.speaker: Oringo
records.source: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ I travel a lot and I'm running quite low on Silent Pearl.
records.translation: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ Я много путешествую, и беззвучные жемчужины почти закончились.

records.speaker: Oringo
records.source: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ If you bring me 64 of them, I'll give you my contact.
records.translation: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ Принесёшь 64 штуки — дам свой номер.

records.speaker: Oringo
records.source: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ Great! Silent Pearls can be pretty useful sometimes.
records.translation: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ Отлично! Беззвучные жемчужины порой очень полезны.

records.speaker: Oringo
records.source: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ Hi! Check back later for information on the next Traveling Zoo!
records.translation: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ Привет! Загляни позже — расскажу о следующем Передвижном зоопарке!

records.speaker: Oringo
records.source: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ The Traveling Zoo has arrived! Here are my offerings this year:
records.translation: [NPC] Oringo: ✆ Передвижной зоопарк прибыл! Вот что предлагаю в этом году:

records.speaker: Oringo
records.source: [NPC] Oringo: Oh, you're out of wheat? Alright, I'll come back later then.
records.translation: [NPC] Oringo: О, пшеница закончилась? Ладно, зайду позже.

records.speaker: Librarian
records.source: [NPC] Librarian: Greetings! Welcome to the Library!
records.translation: [NPC] Librarian: Приветствую! Добро пожаловать в библиотеку!

records.speaker: Librarian
records.source: [NPC] Librarian: The Library is your one-stop shop for all things enchanting. Enchant items, purchase Enchanted Books, and more!
records.translation: [NPC] Librarian: В библиотеке есть всё для зачарования: зачаровывай предметы, покупай зачарованные книги и не только!

records.speaker: Librarian
records.source: [NPC] Librarian: You can enchant items by clicking any Enchantment Table. Enchanting costs experience levels - the more levels you spend, the better enchantments you will receive.
records.translation: [NPC] Librarian: Нажми на любой стол зачарований, чтобы зачаровать предмет. Это стоит уровней опыта: чем больше потратишь, тем лучше зачарования.

records.speaker: Librarian
records.source: [NPC] Librarian: Use the Enchantment Table to enchant an item!
records.translation: [NPC] Librarian: Используй стол зачарований, чтобы зачаровать предмет!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: I'm the town Blacksmith! I can reforge items for you, for a price.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Я городской кузнец! Перекую твои предметы — за плату.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: Reforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for Coal x10.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Обычно перековка стоит монет, но сегодня я добрый: первый предмет перекую за уголь x10.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: Go into the Mine to collect Coal, then come back to learn how to reforge items!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Добудь уголь в шахте и возвращайся — научу перековке!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: Mine some more Coal in the Mine!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Добудь ещё угля в шахте!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: I will teach you how to reforge items once you mine some more Coal!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Добудь ещё угля — и я научу тебя перековке!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: Reach Mining Level I to gain access to the Gold Mine, north of the Coal Mine.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Достигни I уровня горного дела, чтобы попасть в Золотую шахту к северу от Угольной шахты.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: The Gold Mine is more dangerous than the Coal Mine, but it has better ores and treasures!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: В Золотой шахте опаснее, чем в Угольной шахте, зато руда и сокровища лучше!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: Travel to the Gold Mine to spelunk for better ores, including iron and gold!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Отправляйся в Золотую шахту за рудой получше, в том числе железом и золотом!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: Ahh, excellent!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: А, превосходно!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: Reforging items allows you to get the most out of your weapons, armor, and other items by applying stat modifiers to them!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Перековка улучшает характеристики оружия, брони и других предметов!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: To reforge an item, place an item in my inventory. Reforging costs Coins - the more prestigious items cost more to reforge!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Для перековки положи предмет в мой инвентарь. Она стоит монет: чем ценнее предмет, тем дороже.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: However, this time I will reforge any item for the low price of Coal x10!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: Но сейчас перекую любой предмет всего за уголь x10!

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ You want my contact?
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Хочешь мой номер?

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Nonono, not happening.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Не-не-не, ни за что.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Well... Actually...
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Хотя... Вообще-то...

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ No, no absolutely not.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Нет, нет, точно нет.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Unless? Hmm, lemme think about it.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Разве что... Хм, дай подумать.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ No for sure, for sure. That would be too much.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Нет, точно нет. Это уже слишком.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ But maybe... If you do something for me.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Но, может... Если кое-что сделаешь для меня.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Don't ask me how I got into this situation.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Не спрашивай, как я в это вляпался.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ I owe them 32M coins.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Я должен им 32M монет.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ If you help me, I'll allow you to use my services from anywhere.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Поможешь — сможешь пользоваться моими услугами откуда угодно.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ You are a lifesaver.
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Ты мой спаситель.

records.speaker: Blacksmith
records.source: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ I swear I wont get in that trouble again!
records.translation: [NPC] Blacksmith: ✆ Клянусь, больше в такое не вляпаюсь!

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: Hi, I'm the janitor of this mine.
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: Привет, я уборщик этой шахты.

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: You would not believe how many people leave ingots and stones behind them!
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: Не поверишь, сколько людей бросают за собой слитки и камни!

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: It drives me insane, but at least you unlocked Auto-pickup.
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: С ума от этого схожу! Хорошо хоть ты открыл автоподбор.

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: It drives me insane, but at least you'll unlock Auto-pickup at SkyBlock Level 6.
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: С ума от этого схожу! Хорошо хоть на 6-м уровне SkyBlock ты откроешь автоподбор.

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: It makes my job a lot easier, but despite that, I still find so many items on the ground.
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: Так работать гораздо легче. Но на земле всё равно полно вещей!

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: Maybe some of those items are yours? In which case I'll let you buy them back.
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: Может, часть этих вещей твоя? Тогда разрешу их выкупить.

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: Maybe some of these items are yours? In which case I'll let you buy them back.
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: Может, часть этих вещей твоя? Тогда разрешу их выкупить.

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: You found the Lazy Miner's pickaxe!
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: Ты нашёл кирку Ленивого шахтёра!

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: I'll have to put it in my stores.
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: Отправлю её к себе на склад.

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: Click me again!
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: Нажми на меня ещё раз!

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Did I find an Abiphone?
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Находил ли я Абифон?

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Yes, sometimes I do find one lying around.
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Да, иногда попадаются брошенные.

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ What?
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Что?

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ You...
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Ты...

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ You want my contact?
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Хочешь мой номер?

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Me?
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Мой?

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ The janitor?
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Уборщика?

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ I...
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Я...

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ I don't... don't know what to say...
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Я даже... не знаю, что сказать...

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Yes of course you can have it!
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: ✆ Да, конечно, бери!

records.speaker: Rusty
records.source: [NPC] Rusty: Turns out, if you want something done, you have to do it yourself.
records.translation: [NPC] Rusty: Хочешь сделать хорошо — сделай сам.

records.speaker: Frosty
records.source: [NPC] Frosty: Welcome to the Jerry's Workshop.
records.translation: [NPC] Frosty: Добро пожаловать в мастерскую Джерри.

records.speaker: Frosty
records.source: [NPC] Frosty: When its time to deliver Gifts, Mount Jerry always erupts and the village is ravaged by heat-based enemies!
records.translation: [NPC] Frosty: Когда пора раздавать подарки, вулкан Джерри извергается, а деревню атакуют огненные враги!

records.speaker: Frosty
records.source: [NPC] Frosty: It holds and fires Snowballs, which are the best way to extinguish the enemy!
records.translation: [NPC] Frosty: Она хранит снежки и стреляет ими — это лучший способ потушить врага!

records.speaker: Frosty
records.source: [NPC] Frosty: I can refill it at any time for a modest price. Also feel free to check out my shop upstairs!
records.translation: [NPC] Frosty: Пополню боезапас в любое время за небольшую плату. Загляни и в мой магазин наверху!

records.speaker: Frosty
records.source: [NPC] Frosty: Click me with a Snow Cannon, Snow Blaster, or Frosty the Howitzer to refill it!
records.translation: [NPC] Frosty: Нажми на меня со снежной пушкой, снежным бластером или гаубицей Фрости в руке — пополню боезапас!

records.speaker: Frosty
records.source: [NPC] Frosty: I noticed you don't have a Snow Cannon, would you like to buy another?
records.translation: [NPC] Frosty: Вижу, снежной пушки у тебя нет. Купишь ещё одну?

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: You're so close! Find the last Gift and come back for a reward!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Почти готово! Найди последний подарок и возвращайся за наградой!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: You found all of the Gifts!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Все подарки найдены!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: Take this Green Gift! You'll hopefully find something nicer than what was in those White Gifts!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Держи зелёный подарок! Надеюсь, внутри что-то получше, чем в белых подарках.

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: If you haven't already, be sure to give your other Gifts away to others. Giving Gifts benefits both you and the receiver!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Остались подарки? Дари подарки другим — полезно вам обоим!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: I see you've found some Gifts, but there are still many more in the village. Find the rest and come back for a reward!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Часть подарков найдена, но в деревне ещё много. Собери остальные и возвращайся за наградой!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Of course I can add you as a contact!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Конечно, добавлю тебя в контакты!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ It's a really big Abiphone!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Абифон огромный!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ If you want my contact, all you have to do is repeat this phrase exactly...
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Для получения номера повтори эту фразу точно, на английском...

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ "I love the warmth of the Holidays despite the snow"
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Введи на английском: "I love the warmth of the Holidays despite the snow"

style_anchors.source: I love the warmth of the Holidays despite the snow
style_anchors.target: I love the warmth of the Holidays despite the snow

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ That's grandiose!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Грандиозно!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ I really like you!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Ты мне нравишься!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Call me every year and I'll hand you a White Gift!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Звони ежегодно — получишь белый подарок!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ I sent a gift to your inventory! With love, St. Jerry.
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Подарок в твоём инвентаре! С любовью, святой Джерри.

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ But hey, merry season of the Jerry to you anyway!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ В любом случае, с сезоном Джерри!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Call me again next year!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Позвони в следующем году!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: Golly gee - I want to spread joy around the world, in the form of raw materials!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Ох ты! Хочу дарить миру радость в виде ресурсов!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: Your help has been the greatest gift of all.
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Твоя помощь — лучший подарок.

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: Without your help, I can only supply plain white gifts this holiday.
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Без тебя в праздник смогу раздавать лишь белые подарки.

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: Did you know you can access your Bank from Jerry's Workshop? Check out the Bank in the center of the village!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: В мастерской Джерри есть банк! Банк — в центре деревни.

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: Click someone with a Gift to give both you and them a Gift!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Нажми подарком на игрока — подарок получите оба!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: Come back next SkyBlock year to find more Gifts!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Возвращайся за подарками в следующем году SkyBlock!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: Ice fishing is a great way to relax during the winter!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Подлёдная рыбалка — отличный зимний отдых!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: There are all sorts of icy creatures within the depths of Jerry Pond!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: В глубинах пруда Джерри полно ледяных существ!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: You can trade Gifts directly with others or randomly gift players on the island!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Обменивайся подарками или дари их случайным игрокам острова!

records.speaker: St. Jerry
records.source: [NPC] St. Jerry: Gifting others benefits both you and the other person!
records.translation: [NPC] St. Jerry: Подарки полезны и дарителю, и получателю!

records.speaker: Chantelle
records.source: [NPC] Chantelle: Ever feel like you're being watched?
records.translation: [NPC] Chantelle: Бывало чувство, что за тобой следят?

records.speaker: Chantelle
records.source: [NPC] Chantelle: Like your every action is being recorded and monitored?
records.translation: [NPC] Chantelle: Будто каждое действие записывают и отслеживают?

records.speaker: Chantelle
records.source: [NPC] Chantelle: Well, that sure is the case here at The Carnival...
records.translation: [NPC] Chantelle: Что ж, на Карнавале именно так...

records.speaker: Chantelle
records.source: [NPC] Chantelle: ...but it's just so we can track your stats and let you complete challenges for rewards!
records.translation: [NPC] Chantelle: ...но лишь для учёта статистики и испытаний с наградами!

records.speaker: Chantelle
records.source: [NPC] Chantelle: Don't think too hard about it.
records.translation: [NPC] Chantelle: Не забивай себе этим голову.

records.speaker: Chantelle
records.source: [NPC] Chantelle: I like to press a flower for each place the Carnival stops at. Do you have any?
records.translation: [NPC] Chantelle: Я засушиваю по цветку из каждого места остановки Карнавала. У тебя найдётся?

records.speaker: Chantelle
records.source: [NPC] Chantelle: Thank you! These smell amazing!
records.translation: [NPC] Chantelle: Спасибо! Чудесный аромат!

records.speaker: Chantelle
records.source: [NPC] Chantelle: Oh, that's unfortunate. Maybe next time?
records.translation: [NPC] Chantelle: Ох, жаль. Может, в другой раз?

records.speaker: Doug
records.source: [NPC] Doug: Masks. Event buffs. An Accessory.
records.translation: [NPC] Doug: Маски. Бонусы событий. Аксессуар.

records.speaker: Doug
records.source: [NPC] Doug: You want them?
records.translation: [NPC] Doug: Хочешь их?

records.speaker: Doug
records.source: [NPC] Doug: They're yours, my friend.
records.translation: [NPC] Doug: Они твои, друг мой.

records.speaker: Doug
records.source: [NPC] Doug: As long as you have enough Carnival Tokens.
records.translation: [NPC] Doug: Если хватит карнавальных жетонов.
